### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Estimate length bias coefficients in automated LLM-as-a-judge preferences and subtract length discrepancy effects.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def cs336_l12_judge_length_debiasing(scores_a: list, scores_b: list, lengths_a: list, lengths_b: list) -> dict:
    ds = np.array(scores_a, dtype=float) - np.array(scores_b, dtype=float)
    dl = np.array(lengths_a, dtype=float) - np.array(lengths_b, dtype=float)
    if np.all(dl == dl[0]):
        slope, intercept = 0.0, float(np.mean(ds))
    else:
        slope, intercept = np.polyfit(dl, ds, 1)
    return {'length_bias_coefficient': round(float(slope), 6), 'intrinsic_preference_intercept': round(float(intercept), 6), 'debiased_score_diffs': np.round(ds - slope * dl, 6).tolist()}
```
